safety_notes.value: Bend your knees on leg raises, keep reverse crunches small, and press your back down on the hollow hold and the bug. Still hurts? Skip the move and see a doctor or physio.
safety_notes.evidence_location: landing FAQ 'My lower back hurts on some moves.'

safety_notes.value: Not medical advice. If you have back pain or a health condition, or you're pregnant, talk to a doctor first. Under 18: only with an adult supervising; skip the diet part.

value: Abs A
Abs C
Forearms on the floor, elbows right under your shoulders.
Step your feet back. Your body is one straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your stomach, as if someone is about to poke it.
Breathe normally. Stop when your hips sag or lift.

works.value: The whole front: the six-pack (rectus abdominis) and the deep muscle under it.

mistakes_to_avoid.value: Hips sagging toward the floor, or hips up in the air. Holding your breath.

easier.value: Knees on the floor, or hands on a chair.

harder.value: Shoulder taps: lift one hand at a time without letting your hips rock.

be_safe.value: If your lower back aches, drop to your knees or shorten the hold.

value: Abs A
Lie on your back, arms by your sides, knees bent at 90° above your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor and bring your knees toward your chest.
Lower slowly, for 2 to 3 seconds, until your hips touch down.
No swinging. If your legs fly, your abs aren't doing the work.

value: Abs A
Lie on your back, arms up to the ceiling, knees bent at 90° over your hips.
Press your lower back flat into the floor, and keep it there the whole time.
Slowly reach one arm back and the opposite leg out, just above the floor.
Come back to the middle and switch sides. That's 1 rep per side.

value: Abs B
Lie on your side, forearm on the floor, elbow right under your shoulder.
Stack your feet, or put the top foot just in front.
Lift your hips until your body is one straight line from head to feet.
Hold and breathe, then switch sides. Both sides get the same time.

Abs C
Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. From CARVE on, hug a water jug to your chest.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor: ribs toward hips.
At the top, squeeze your abs hard for 2 seconds.
Lower slowly. Never pull on your neck.

Lie on your back and press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and legs a little off the floor. Arms reach forward, or past your head.
Your body makes a shallow banana shape. Your lower back stays down.
Hold and breathe. When your back lifts, bend your knees or stop.

value: Abs C
Lie on your back, hands flat by your hips, lower back pressed down.
Keep your legs together and lift them to about 45°. In FOUNDATION, bend your knees.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
If your lower back lifts, stop higher or bend your knees.
